parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?
When should I use AlphaFold2 for monomer folding versus Boltz-2 or AlphaFold3 for complex structure prediction in FoldRun?
Which structure prediction models in FoldRun support folding a protein bound to a small-molecule SMILES ligand?

FoldRun supports protein-ligand complex prediction with small-molecule SMILES or CCD ligands using AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3, whereas AlphaFold2 only supports standard amino acid monomer and multimer protein sequences.
